reviewMethod: Original agency accession or geotagged uploader evidence + license page + visually inspected thumbnail; subject and license independently checked.
hosting: Wikimedia Commons 960px CDN thumbnails with attribution; images remain remotely hosted until approved asset-ingestion pipeline is established.
scope: Four researched public guide pages only. No photos inferred for the other 76 destinations, no research-only held waterfalls, no generic UP landscape substitutes.
restrictions: Never download/reuse general Michigan.gov photography solely because it is a state site; use its documented approved portfolio or obtain permission.
Do not publish photos with All Rights Reserved, CC NC, no derivatives without exact compliant use, or unverifiable subject identity.
Credit photo creator, original source and license visibly beside each image.
An image's GPS locates a camera, not safe visitor parking or legal access.
No fabricated maps or current conditions inferred from old photography.
